_meta.note: Sourced from Razorpay's own sample payloads for payment.dispute.created. Field names are copied exactly — including 'term_and_conditions' (singular 'term'), which differs from a common assumption of 'terms_and_conditions'.

payment_entity_shape._note: Only fields Shield Assist actually consumes are guaranteed to be read; the rest pass through untouched.

_field_notes.amount: integer, in currency subunits (paise for INR) — divide by 100 for rupees
_field_notes.respond_by: unix timestamp — deadline to submit evidence, used for priority/urgency scoring
_field_notes.reason_code: Razorpay's native reason code. For the 6 in-scope codes, map RZP01/RZP04/RZP05/RZP06 to whatever the live enum actually emits — Razorpay's public webhook sample uses generic examples like 'processed_invalid_expired_card', so this mapping MUST be re-verified once real test-mode disputes start arriving in Phase 0's Task 4.
_field_notes.phase: chargeback | fraud | pre_arbitration | arbitration — service disputes we care about should generally be phase=chargeback

evidence_shape._note: Each populated slot (after evidence is attached) becomes either a list of document_id strings, or for 'others' a list of {type, document_ids} objects. All fields are null until the merchant submits.
